description: Start a passive web security scan against an allowlisted target. Returns a job ID for polling.

baselineJobId.description: Prior completed job ID whose report.json should be used as the regression baseline

baselineReport.description: Path to a baseline report.json under output/ for regression comparison

profiles.description: Path to a profiles JSON file inside the repository root

targetUrl.description: The target URL to scan (must be in the allowlist)

name: start_scan
